name: KALIUM SULPHURICUM
key_symptoms: Tongue coated yellow and slimy. Insipid, pappy taste. Gums painful. Burning thirst, nausea, and vomiting. Load feeling. Dread of hot drinks.
Rheumatic headache, beginning in evening. Bald spots. Dandruff and scaldhead.

Coarse rales. Rattling of mucus in chest (Tart em). Post-grippal cough, especially in children. Bronchial asthma, with yellow expectoration. Cough; worse in evening and in hot atmosphere. Croupy hoarseness (Hep; Spong).
Pain in nape, back and limbs, worse in warm room. Shifting, wandering pains.

gi_symptoms: Tongue coated yellow and slimy. Insipid, pappy taste. Gums painful. Burning thirst, nausea, and vomiting. Load feeling. Dread of hot drinks.
urinary_symptoms: Gonorrhœa; discharge slimy, yellowish-green. Orchitis. Gleet.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain in nape, back and limbs, worse in warm room. Shifting, wandering pains.
skin_symptoms: Psoriasis (Ars; Thyroid). Eczema; burning, itching, papular eruption. Nettle-rash. Polypi. Epithelioma. Seborrhœa. Favus. Ring-worm of scalp or beard with abundant scales.
fever_symptoms: Rise of temperature at night. Intermittent fever, with yellow, slimy tongue.
